name: AZANIAN
blurb: A luxury South African long-haul carrier connecting the Cape with major cities across Europe, the Middle East and North America.

about: AZANIAN is a luxury South African carrier connecting the Cape to the world and beyond. The airline operates exclusively long-haul services with a fleet of premium wide-body aircraft.
network: From Cape Town, AZANIAN serves Budapest, Dubai, New York, Frankfurt, Paris, Los Angeles, San Francisco and Houston.
